## Summary

Describe the publication, locale, renderer, or release change.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] Generated Markdown was reviewed on GitHub-compatible rendering.
- [ ] Every changed PDF page was rendered and visually inspected.
- [ ] Published locale status reflects completed human review.

## Governance

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, secrets, private paths, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Provider APIs, CLIs, telemetry, billing, quota, and usage claims are evidence-calibrated.
- [ ] Official hosted services and managed infrastructure are represented accurately.
- [ ] Branding, package names, release identity, and domains are not misleading.
- [ ] Release artifacts and provenance surfaces match the source commit.
